profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer and Manager at Google
profile.summary:
Application and platform-level software and user interface design.  Good at product development, and managing engineers.

Specialties:  Android, Java, managing, mobile software architecture, consumer application UI.

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description:
Key member of Nook's Android-based software team.  Managed a development team in Taiwan on a 1-year overseas assignment.
Shipped the following products:
--- Galaxy Tab S2 Nook (2015)
--- Nook for Android 4.0 (2015)
--- Galaxy Tab 4 Nook (2014)
--- Nook Glowlight (2013)
--- Nook HD (2012)
--- Nook Glowlight (2012)
--- Nook Tablet (2011)
--- Nook Simple Touch (2011)
--- Nook Color (2010)
--- Nook (2009)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote four video games from scratch, which was fun.  Remotely managed a team of overseas (China) developers.  Worked on the inaugural Android product launch (G1).

positions.description: A brief foray into the enterprise world.
